hook: Arthur Conan Doyle wrote that Watson compared Holmes's deductive powers to supernatural abilities, risking execution.

sections.voiceover: The stakes rose in 1978 when author Loren D. Estleman wrote a crossover novel. This book depicts a direct encounter between the detective and the legendary Count Dracula.

sections.voiceover: On page 121, the detective finally meets the legendary Count Dracula face-to-face. Academic Daniel Cottom identifies this clash as the fantastic end of the bohemian figure.
